```{python}
from fairdatanow import data_now, login

url = "https://laboppad.nl/ukiyo-e-world"


login(url)

toml_txt = """
[data.tif]
RV-1-4468-544 = ".*akama.*RV-1-4468-544[.]tif"
"""

files = data_now(url, toml_txt)

object_num = next(iter(files["tif"]))
tif_path = files["tif"][object_num][0]
```

```{python}
import plotly.express as px
import dash_ag_grid as dag
from PIL import Image
from dash import Dash, Input, Output, Patch, State, dcc, html

with Image.open(tif_path) as source:
    image = source.convert("RGB")

fig = px.imshow(image, binary_string=True, title=object_num)

# Add point layer
fig.add_scatter(
    x=[], y=[], mode="markers",
    marker=dict(color="red", size=12, line=dict(color="white", width=2)),
    showlegend=False,
)

# Lock tif in place
width, height = image.size
fig.update_xaxes(range=[-0.5, width - 0.5], autorange=False)
fig.update_yaxes(range=[height - 0.5, -0.5], autorange=False)
fig.update_layout(uirevision="tif")

# Dash app creation
app = Dash(__name__)
app.layout = html.Div([
    dcc.Graph(figure=fig, id="graph"),
    dag.AgGrid(
        id="points-grid",
        columnDefs=[
            {"field": "point"},
            {"field": "text", "editable": True, "cellDataType": "text"},
            {"field": "x"},
            {"field": "y"},
        ],
        rowData=[],
        dashGridOptions={"stopEditingWhenCellsLoseFocus": True}
    ),
])

# Point callbacks
@app.callback(
    Output("graph", "figure"),
    Output("points-grid", "rowData"),
    Input("graph", "clickData"),
    State("points-grid", "rowData"),
    prevent_initial_call=True,
)
def place_point(click_data, rows):
    # Find clicked point
    point = click_data["points"][0]
    patch = Patch()
    grid_patch = Patch()
    # If the scatter layer [1] is clicked instead of the fig [0] then delete the point
    if point["curveNumber"] == 1:
        index = point["pointIndex"]
        del patch["data"][1]["x"][index]
        del patch["data"][1]["y"][index]
        del grid_patch[index]
        for row_index in range(index, len(rows) - 1):
            grid_patch[row_index]["point"] = row_index + 1
    # Add the point using patches to both the scatter layer and the AG Grid
    else:
        patch["data"][1]["x"].append(point["x"])
        patch["data"][1]["y"].append(point["y"])
        grid_patch.append({
            "point": len(rows) + 1, "text": "", "x": point["x"], "y": point["y"]
        })
    return patch, grid_patch

app.run(jupyter_mode="inline", debug=False)
```
